brief: GS consumer desk morning note, 13 Nov 2026. Futures are firmer (SPX +25bps, NDX +15bps, RTY +25bps), the 10-year yield down 2.5bps to 4.85%, WTI off 10bps to $88.65, amid light newsflow beyond a global Microsoft 365 outage (MSFT -1.5% premarket). NVDA is rebounding 2%. Post-earnings movers: CBRS +17%, AMAT +60bps, CSCO -2.75%. Today's docket: US PPI, Eurozone GDP, four Fed speakers, and the RVTY investor day. Ahead: Warsh on 11/16, NVDA earnings 11/17, major retail prints, Tencent and BABA results, and the Trump-Xi meeting 11/18-19. Consumer discretionary has lagged the market for a third straight session and has given back most of its post-election outperformance. The desk reads this as a return to the 1H26 regime, driven partly by a momentum/factor rotation favoring 12-month winners (where AI positioning is cleaner), with consumer holding less or the wrong-way exposure there. The desk notes as interesting that future momentum-index rebalances should be supportive of consumer. Earnings: DDS +0.5% (modest EPS and comp beat), FLO -9% (EPS and EBITDA miss with a deep FY guide cut, the Nature's Own relaunch slower than expected), OFRM -8% (3Q revenue and EBITDA beat overshadowed by an FY guide cut tied to the Tractor Wheels recall).
